interpretation.dynamax: Dynamax 1.0.1 fails importing its LGSSM implementation because main TFP 0.25.0 accesses the removed JAX pytype_aval_mappings API; the numerical likelihood was not reached.
interpretation.bayesnf: BayesNF 0.1.3 fails importing spatiotemporal because main TFP 0.25.0 accesses the removed JAX pytype_aval_mappings API; training and prediction were not reached.
interpretation.pygam: PyGAM 0.12.0 passed this bounded spline fit with main SciPy 1.18.1. Its published scipy<1.17,>=1.11.1 requirement remains unsatisfied. This is a declared dependency conflict, not a demonstrated runtime failure in this test; the check does not establish all PyGAM functionality.
interpretation.installation_scope: Only missing reference packages/dependencies were made readable from the companion site-packages. Main packages and both environments were left unchanged. Inactive dev/doc/test extras are omitted from the published receipt.
